prowler.gcp.cloudsql_instance_private_ip.reason: The pinned Prowler metadata asks whether a Cloud SQL instance has a public incoming IP, but its loop treats every non-PRIVATE ipAddresses type as public. Native evaluation corrects that source false positive: PRIMARY and migrated V1 public addresses fail; OUTGOING is an outbound source address and does not fail this incoming-address check. Missing or unknown address types remain UNKNOWN, and a PASS does not assert a private incoming endpoint or effective reachability.

review_notes.applicability: Cloud SQL instance ipAddresses declarations only; PSC and privateNetwork do not replace a missing address list. OUTGOING-only passes absence of public incoming IP without proving a private incoming endpoint; collection unavailable or unknown enum remains UNKNOWN.
review_notes.semantic_correction: Pinned evaluator FAILs address.type != PRIVATE while pinned metadata says no public IP and internet-exposed. Google IpMapping documents PRIMARY as public incoming, PRIVATE as private incoming, OUTGOING as outbound source, and MIGRATED_1ST_GEN as legacy V1 IP to decommission. FAIL only PRIMARY or MIGRATED_1ST_GEN for this check; preserve pinned source hash as provenance.
